title: pleopeltis loriformis
intro: Pleopeltis loriformis, commonly known as the lizard's tail or Loriformis, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis loriformis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through various studies on the plant's chemical composition.
